subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins use the existing system-event/inbound-runner primitives for non-message activity, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or dispatch API?
rationale: The source confirms a real public-SDK gap, but choosing between documentation, system-event conventions, inbound.run semantics, or a new hook changes third-party compatibility and overlaps with existing open implementation work.

options.title: Document Existing System Events
options.body: Treat reactions, edits, read receipts, and similar notifications as routed system events, document the channel-plugin recipe, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A New Event Contract
options.body: Define a typed event adapter or hook for non-message channel activity and align it with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79855 before merging implementation work.

options.title: Defer For Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch that shows why current system-event and channel-ingress primitives cannot solve the use case.

recommendation.title: Document Existing System Events
recommendation.body: Treat reactions, edits, read receipts, and similar notifications as routed system events, document the channel-plugin recipe, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing candidate from recent plugin SDK/channel runtime history and current-main provenance.
